page_title: JUV 2-2 PAR | Juventus v Parma 30/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+5' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
90+4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+4' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
90+2' The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
90+2' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
90+1' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Pontus Almqvist (Parma) inside the box.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Drissa Camara (Parma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
89' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

89' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
88' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
87' Simon Sohm (Parma) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
86' Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
85' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
84' Fabio Pecchia has decided to make a change. Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) replaces Dennis Man.
84' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Khephren Thuram.

84' What a poor attempt! Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.

83' A sweet pass finds Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Michele Di Gregorio is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
83' A pass from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is intercepted by Zion Suzuki and the move breaks down.
82' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
81' Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
80' Luca Zufferli couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) and blew his whistle.
78' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but Zion Suzuki punches the ball away.
76' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Zion Suzuki (Parma).
74' Hernani (Parma) is being substituted because of an injury. Fabio Pecchia sends Drissa Camara on the pitch.
73' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
71' Here is a change. Weston McKennie is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus).
70' A snap shot by Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Michele Di Gregorio produces a good save to thwart him.
69' Fabio Pecchia decides to make a substitution. Valentin Mihaila will be replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
69' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Ange-Yoan Bonny.
69' Federico Gatti (Juventus) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
69' The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.
68' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
64' Unlucky! A great strike from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
63' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
63' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
61' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
59' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Savona (Juventus) replacing Juan Cabal.
59' Substitution. Timothy Weah did his best and is replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
58' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Luca Zufferli didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
58' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Hernani (Parma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
56' That was close! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
54' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
52' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
49' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Francisco Conceicao plays it into the box, and Timothy Weah (Juventus) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 2:2.
49' Timothy Weah (Juventus) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
47' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Luca Zufferli ignores the protests.
46' Fabio Pecchia has made a change at the break. Hernani has come on in place of Mandela Keita (Parma).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Luca Zufferli has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Simon Sohm (Parma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
45+1' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
45+1' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Juventus force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
42' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) plays a through ball but overhits it.
41' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Timothy Weah (Juventus) heads on.
38' 1 - 2 Simon Sohm (Parma) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the right post in trademark fashion.
38' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
35' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
34' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
34' A player from Juventus brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
32' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.

31' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Timothy Weah sends a superb cross into the box. Weston McKennie (Juventus) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header inside the left post, leaving Zion Suzuki beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
31' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.
31' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Good work from Juventus as they win a corner.
28' Dennis Man (Parma) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
28' A short pass finds Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
26' Weston McKennie (Juventus) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
23' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
23' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
20' Dennis Man (Parma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
19' Parma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Parma earn a corner.
17' The linesman signals that Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
17' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
15' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
15' Timothy Weah (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Juventus win a corner.

13' What a save from Zion Suzuki! Weston McKennie (Juventus) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
13' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes.
11' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

10' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Zufferli with no other option than to blow for a foul.
9' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
7' Federico Gatti (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
7' A cross into the box from Valentin Mihaila (Parma) is cleared.

3' 0 - 1 Enrico Del Prato (Parma) gets to the ball inside the penalty area and produces a bullet header towards the goal. He aims his effort nicely into the top left corner, leaving Michele Di Gregorio helpless. He makes it 0:1.
3' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

2' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio was alert and the score remains the same.
1' Parma are ruled offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Juventus will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Luca Zufferli.
